Israeli actions in West Bank and Gaza draw international attention

Israeli actions in the occupied West Bank and Gaza have led to casualties and international concern. One person was killed in Gaza, and journalists were wounded in the occupied West Bank. Reports indicate Israeli settlers are using sheep farms and intimidation tactics to expand control in the West Bank. Jordan has warned that Israel is attempting to replicate the situation in Gaza by displacing Palestinians in the West Bank. The effectiveness of the Israeli court system in the occupied West Bank has been questioned through the story of one Palestinian family.
